'''Jaggard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] stationed on the war torn [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. At one point, he asked a fellow Imperial to retrieve a bio weapon encased in a canister that was located on a crashed shuttle and hid somewhere in space debris by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]].
